scheme_name: AGR-61 Agro Service Providers for the Purpose of Making Farming More Profitable With the Help of Farm Mechanization
occupation: Individuals with Bachelor of Rural Studies (B.R.S.)
other_conditions: Assistance is available only once in a lifetime for eligible applicants.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% (maximum ₹7.5 lakh) financial assistance for agro service providers, with higher assistance (up to 85% / ₹8.5 lakh) for tribal areas.
